children: Firy announced redemption of $49.7 million of 10.25% secured notes, eliminating its outstanding borrowed indebtedness upon completion.
Delivered notice to redeem all remaining 10.25% Secured Notes due 2026 on Oct 15, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest.
$49,671,000 aggregate principal remained outstanding as of Oct 5, 2026 and will be redeemed, leaving no Notes outstanding.
Redemption funded with proceeds from sale of equity stake in Exit Games; no new capital raised and no shareholder dilution.
Redemption and prior August action expected to save ~ $3.6M in cash interest through maturity; October action saves ~ $0.8M.
Upon redemption, liens and indenture covenants will be released; company expects to enter 2027 without borrowed debt and greater financial flexibility.
